title: Word Search II
hints: Running Word Search I once per word repeats the same board walks for every word that shares a prefix. Which structure shares prefixes?
Put all the words in a trie and DFS from every cell, stepping down the trie as you step across the board; stop the moment the trie has no child for the next letter.

When you reach a node that ends a word, record it and clear the marker so it is not reported twice; then delete trie nodes that lead nowhere any more. Without that pruning, a board of all 'a' with the words a, aa, ..., aaaaaaaaaaaa never finishes.
